review_model.role: all reviews; severity-tagged issues + 0-100 score; fix verified; >=90 gate

generation_model.role: candidates, policy challengers, summaries, extraction, unstick

retrieval.lookup: runner-mediated by cited ID only; every lookup ledgered; overflow => finer sub-partitions, never silent truncation

memo.rules: cross-arm miss by construction; creation charged once to creating arm; replay cache-miss => unsupported

freeze_rule: Any change to prompts/schemas/models/efforts/budgets = new protocol version = new comparison epoch; arms in one comparison share the identical protocol on own admissible histories.

unstick.inputs: arm-admissible history only during frozen comparisons
